readings: For processing runs with memusagegb strictly greater than 60.8 GB and whose zoneref matches a site, first compute, for each site code and entrystat, the average memusagegb and the average of the per-run ratio procgpu/proccpu (as a real-number division), ignoring missing values. Then, for each entrystat, return the entrystat, the average of those per-site memusagegb averages, and the average of those per-site ratio averages, unrounded.

For processing runs with memusagegb greater than or equal to 60.8 GB and whose zoneref matches a site, first compute, for each site code and entrystat, the average memusagegb and the average of the per-run ratio procgpu/proccpu (as a real-number division), ignoring missing values. Then, for each entrystat, return the entrystat, the average of those per-site memusagegb averages, and the average of those per-site ratio averages, unrounded.
queries:
SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_mem), AVG(avg_ratio)
FROM (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat,
         AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_mem,
         AVG(CAST(p.procgpu AS REAL) / p.proccpu) AS avg_ratio
  FROM scanprocessing p
  JOIN sites s ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE p.memusagegb > 60.8
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
)
GROUP BY entrystat;
SELECT entrystat,
       AVG(avg_mem) AS avg_memusagegb,
       AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio
FROM (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry,
         s.entrystat,
         AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_mem,
         AVG(CAST(p.procgpu AS REAL) / p.proccpu) AS avg_ratio
  FROM scanprocessing p
  JOIN sites s ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE p.memusagegb >= 60.8
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
) t
GROUP BY entrystat;
